description: Power Automate flow to read from and add items to IRE Project Tracking SharePoint list

readItems.name: IRE - Get Project Tracking Items
steps: Trigger: Manually trigger a flow (or HTTP request)
Action: SharePoint - Get items (site: intel.sharepoint.com/sites/ire, list: IRE Project Tracking)
Action: Apply to each item (optional filtering)
Action: Return results (Respond to PowerApp or HTTP)

addItem.name: IRE - Add Project Tracking Item
steps: Trigger: Manually trigger a flow (or HTTP request)
Action: SharePoint - Create item (site: intel.sharepoint.com/sites/ire, list: IRE Project Tracking)

notes: Build these flows in Power Automate web UI: https://make.powerautomate.com
Add them to the IREProjectTracking solution from the Solutions menu
Then export using: pac solution export --name IREProjectTracking --path ./solutions
